mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are seeing clear skies and 77 degree temperatures out by Reddan Soccer Park, with an air quality index currently at 52.
In city news, Verona police arrested a nineteen year old man from Madison after a residential burglary attempt occurred on Wednesday, involving a recovered handgun and no reported injuries.

There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, music tomorrow at Paddy Mac's, and the Dane County Farmers' Market happening tomorrow at the Capitol, followed by the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival this Saturday.

On Wednesday, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress, resulting in one suspect being taken into custody and facing charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Heath Crunch, but the store is now closed for the evening, so mark your calendars for OREO REESE'S Cheesecake which will be available when they open tomorrow at 10:30 AM.
